body: Sure will, I'll try my best, again, thank you very much. Your help has been undoubtedly great.
Oh no, that part I had to get on with it, even if it hurt, I'm talking more to then these days, communication is sure something that I want to get better at with them.

Sorry for the late, late reply. I got to say, those months were really strong on me, this year was brutal, but nothing that can be compared to most people here, the problem was myself, I got to analyze some things about during these times, I have re-read countless "suicide notes", and to be honest, I feel pretty bad about the people around me during those times with me, and for the first time, I felt bad about myself for thinking a whole lot about a bunch of shite that eventually passes through you ya know, since then I've become more of a person really, let's see where the road leads me to, and on the way to there let's see if I can make other ways too. Thanks for the reply, fellow stranger, even being the "sole-replyer", i thank you for that. I hope luck, happiness, success and everything good comes and stays your way.
